news.title: Crypto for Advisors: Is the Clarity Act dead?
CME's Duffy warns an overlooked tax risk looms over U.S. perpetual futures
news.summary: CME CEO Terry Duffy said a court battle over whether perpetual futures are swaps or futures could eventually affect how the IRS taxes the contracts. Independent legal experts say the issue remains unresolved.

news.title: The economics behind Aave proposal to ditch 6 chains that earn loose change in revenue
news.summary: A governance proposal would shut deployments on Sonic, Scroll, zkSync, Metis, Soneium and Aptos, and retire 50 asset markets elsewhere. Deposits on some have fallen more than 90%.

news.title: JPMorgan says fading Clarity Act odds weigh on crypto outlook
news.summary: The bank said deteriorating prospects for U.S. market structure legislation remove a key catalyst for digital assets, even as tokenization and institutional adoption advance.

news.title: Institutional crypto trading hits a record 72% as Wall Street calms crypto's wild swings
news.summary: A new report from market maker Wintermute found that institutions now dominate crypto trading, driving lower volatility, selective altcoin flows and growth in tokenized assets.

news.title: Ethereum enters its second decade after a year of upheaval at the foundation
news.summary: Few periods in Ethereum's 11-year history have brought as much change, from leadership shakeups at the Ethereum Foundation to institutional adoption, as the past year has.

news.title: Fake staking site drains $8.5 million in XRP from dozens of investors promising easy yield
news.summary: Seoul police say the amount of the scam might rise to nearly $20 million. Two alleged scammers were detained and a third remains at-large.

news.title: Telegram faces terror-related legal action in Australia one day after founder is charged by Russia
news.summary: The platform faces a fine of up to $38 million for allegedly failing to remove terror-related content.

news.title: Americans are spending plenty — but they’re saving much less
news.summary: Consumer spending rose again in June to cap off a strong second quarter, but households had to dig deep into their savings to pay for their purchases after a recent surge in inflation.

news.title: People from this country are buying up the most homes in America right now, even as international sales dry up
news.summary: International buyers only bought about 67,000 homes in the U.S. over the last 12 months ending in March, a near-record low, according to the National Association of Realtors.

news.title: ‘Don’t get suckered like I did’: I paid $185 to the wrong passport website. Can I get my money back?
news.summary: “I will file a complaint with the Better Business Bureau.”

news.title: Looking for a second home? Sellers in these vacation areas could be ready to make a deal.
news.summary: House hunters could find good prices in second-home markets across the South and Midwest.

news.title: Meta’s stock is falling hard. Here’s why the company is in Wall Street’s doghouse.
news.summary: Meta’s spending on AI is ramping, and investors want proof that the company can make serious money in areas other than advertising.

news.title: PCE inflation gauge falls for the first time since the pandemic. The danger is far from over.
news.summary: The main inflation barometer used by the Federal Reserve to set U.S. interest rates fell in June for the first time since the pandemic, underscoring why the Fed took no action this week to raise borrowing costs.

news.title: Gen Z stays home almost every weekend because going out isn’t worth the money
news.summary: Forget FOMO: Fear of financial regret is keeping younger Americans at home on Saturday night.
